fields.label: Air temperature
fields.description: Air temperature about 6.6 feet above the ground.

fields.label: Dew point
fields.description: Gridded near-surface dew point.

fields.label: Station-trained temperature
fields.description: 0.05° station-trained model output; not an actual station observation.

fields.label: Station-trained dew point
fields.description: 0.05° station-trained dew point forecast.

fields.label: Surface wind speed
fields.description: Scalar wind speed at 10 metres. Not wind gusts.

fields.label: Eastward wind · 10m
fields.description: Signed eastward wind component at 10 metres.

fields.label: Northward wind · 10m
fields.description: Signed northward wind component at 10 metres.

fields.label: Turbine-height wind speed
fields.description: Scalar wind speed at 100 metres. Not wind gusts.

fields.label: Eastward wind · 100m
fields.description: Signed eastward wind component at 100 metres.

fields.label: Northward wind · 100m
fields.description: Signed northward wind component at 100 metres.

fields.label: Model-native precipitation
fields.description: Liquid-equivalent precipitation accumulated over the hour ending at the displayed time. Not a probability of rain.

fields.label: IMERG-trained precipitation
fields.description: Satellite-trained precipitation forecast, not current satellite observations.

fields.label: Satellite-radar-trained precipitation
fields.description: Experimental satellite-radar-trained precipitation forecast, not live radar.

fields.label: Total cloud cover
fields.description: Cloud fraction converted to percent. Cloud layers are not additive.

fields.label: High cloud cover
fields.description: Cloud fraction converted to percent. Cloud layers are not additive.

fields.label: Mid-level cloud cover
fields.description: Cloud fraction converted to percent. Cloud layers are not additive.

fields.label: Low cloud cover
fields.description: Cloud fraction converted to percent. Cloud layers are not additive.

fields.label: Solar radiation · total
fields.description: One-hour downward solar energy divided by 3,600 seconds: average irradiance, not UV index.

fields.label: Solar radiation · direct
fields.description: One-hour direct solar energy divided by 3,600 seconds. Not UV index.

fields.label: Sea-level pressure
fields.description: Mean sea-level pressure, not station surface pressure.

fields.label: Sea-surface temperature
fields.description: Ocean surface temperature. May be missing or not meaningful at an inland grid cell.
